# hiok_docker_stack (Resource)

A compose stack: several containers described together in one file.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stack name.

### Optional

- `compose` (String) The compose file itself. Use file() to read one from disk.
- `region` (String)
- `remove_volumes_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether destroying the stack also removes its volumes. Off by default: a stack is often rebuilt, and the data is the part nobody wants to lose by accident.
- `storage_path` (String) A compose file already in a storage account, as "account/path/docker-compose.yml".

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
